title: All Water Adventures

services.name: fly fishing
services.desc: All Water Adventures can accommodate small to large groups, we also have several boats available for even larger parties. Although we can’t promise you will catch a trophy shark, we can promise we will give it every effort and make sure to have a good time! The waters a couple miles out of Cape Canaveral can be good for a wide array of sharks and giant rays. Our most popular trips are evening/night shark trips where we fish from 3-5 hours, soaking our shark baits in the shadow of the Space Center. services.name: Airboat Tours
services.desc: Central Florida Airboat Tours is the premier Space Coast airboat tour that explores the beauty and nature of the St. Johns River. Perfect for families and small groups. Along this ride, you can expect to see many different creatures including alligators, turtles, frogs, countless species of birds, fish, plants, and maybe even Bigfoot! The serene environment will relax you as you take in all that nature here has to offer, and at the same time having the thrill of riding Winding trails, shallow waters, and swamplands on the airboat that will keep you wanting to see more and more.
